title: Household Add-On Membership: minimum term, early-termination fee and relocation-waiver basis
content:
## Scope
This document states, for each Household Add-On Membership tier, the minimum commitment term, the flat early-termination fee amount, whether a relocation waiver of that fee is available for the tier, and the relocation radius that qualifies.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Minimum commitment term | Early-termination fee (flat) | Relocation waiver available | Qualifying relocation radius |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Spouse Add-On | 1 month | $0.00 | yes | 50 miles |
| Domestic Partner Add-On | 1 month | $0.00 | yes | 50 miles |
| Dependent Child Add-On | 1 month | $0.00 | yes | 50 miles |
| Young Adult Add-On | 1 month | $0.00 | yes | 50 miles |
| Senior Parent Add-On | 1 month | $0.00 | yes | 50 miles |
| Household Multi-Add-On | 1 month | $0.00 | yes | 50 miles |

## Points of judgement
- Every current tier sets its minimum commitment term at 1 month and its flat early-termination fee amount at $0.00; the term and the fee amount are each set independently per tier in this table, so a future rate table could vary either one by tier without changing the other.
- Every current tier makes the relocation waiver available, with a qualifying radius of 50 miles from the club the dependent was enrolled at.
- The qualifying radius is a distance threshold on the documented relocation itself; it is not a count of months or a dollar amount, and it carries no separate notice period of its own.
